component.name: WaveLinux 6
component.summary: Creator audio mixer for PipeWire desktops

description.p: WaveLinux 6 provides persistent virtual audio channels, live effects, application routing, stream mixes, and hardware-aware device selection.
Prevents stale capture-stream moves from reaching PipeWire-Pulse after a recording client exits.
Security-focused Rust and frontend dependency updates with a stable updater feed.
Persistent native PipeWire audio core, live DSP, adaptive latency, and verified cross-distribution installation.
